(api-gui-forms-buttonbase)=
## ButtonBase

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/button_base/button_base.hpp>
class ButtonBase : public Control
```

ButtonBase is the authoritative retained command state machine for pointer, keyboard, mnemonic, semantic, and dialog activation, with theme/compatibility rendering, image-list resolution, content alignment, explicit padding, disclosure state, and lifetime-safe events.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ButtonBase`.

(api-gui-forms-button)=
## Button

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/button_base/button/button.hpp>
class Button : public ButtonBase
```

Button specializes ButtonBase with accept/cancel dialog results, default-button state, four public visual policies, bounded flat-border width, and event ordering that commits dialog state before command publication.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `Button`.

- Publishes `clicked` after committing any non-None `DialogResult` to the owning Window. `DialogResult` uses the exact WinForms numeric values and undefined gaps are rejected.
- `Window::set_accept_button` transfers the default-button cue; Enter and Escape route to live accept/cancel targets only after the focused route declines the key.
- `perform_click()` (inherited) uses the same availability and validation gate as mnemonic and dialog commands. Four public visual styles and a bounded flat-border width are retained.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit Button(StableId stable_id, std::string text = {})` | Constructs a ButtonBase with standard visual policy and no dialog result. |
| `bool default_button() const noexcept` | Reports whether Window currently designates this command as the default action. |
| `void set_default_button(bool is_default)` | Commits the default cue and invalidates paint and semantics. |
| `DialogResult dialog_result() const noexcept` | Returns the result assigned to successful activation. |
| `void set_dialog_result(DialogResult result)` | Validates the dialog-result vocabulary, commits it, and publishes dialog_result_changed. |
| `Event<DialogResult>& dialog_result_changed() noexcept` | Returns the event published after dialog result commits. |
| `ButtonVisualStyle visual_style() const noexcept` | Returns standard, flat, accent, or command presentation policy. |
| `void set_visual_style(ButtonVisualStyle style)` | Validates the closed visual vocabulary and invalidates size, style, paint, and semantics. |
| `bool selected() const noexcept` |  |

| `void on_paint(Painter& painter, Rect local_damage) override` | Resolves the selected visual role/style and records default/focus/content cues. |
| `Insets visual_outsets() const noexcept override` | Reports outsets for the active role recipe or compatibility rendering. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` |  |

(api-gui-forms-dropdownbutton)=
## DropDownButton

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/button_base/button/drop_down_button/drop_down_button.hpp>
class DropDownButton final : public Button
```

DropDownButton specializes Button with an explicit disclosure actuator: menu mode routes the whole button to the owned popup, while split mode retains a primary Click region and a bounded disclosure region at the trailing edge.

Status: provisional. WinForms counterpart: `ToolStripSplitButton`.

(api-gui-forms-linklabel)=
## LinkLabel

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/button_base/link_label/link_label.hpp>
class LinkLabel : public ButtonBase
```

LinkLabel is a ButtonBase command presented as underlined link text, with retained visited state committed before click publication and link semantics.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `LinkLabel`.

- A single retained link rendered as underlined text. Visited state is committed before `clicked` is published.
- External navigation is application policy; the control performs none.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit LinkLabel(StableId stable_id, std::string text = {})` | Constructs an ordinary ButtonBase command using link presentation. |
| `bool visited() const noexcept` | Reports whether the link has completed activation. |
| `void set_visited(bool visited)` | Commits visited state and invalidates paint and semantics. |
| `void on_paint(Painter& painter, Rect local_damage) override` | Records resolved link text color, underline geometry, and focus cue without a button frame. |
| `void on_activate() override` | Marks the link visited before publishing the inherited click event. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects link role, visited state, displayed name, and press action. |

(api-gui-forms-commandbar)=
## CommandBar

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/collections/command_bar.hpp>
class CommandBar final : public Panel
```

CommandBar is a Panel-derived strip of retained item Buttons built from authored CommandItem records with borrowed Command authority and optional key shortcuts; one invoked notification survives list replacement so consumers never resubscribe per item.

Status: provisional. WinForms counterpart: `ToolStrip`.
